title: WhatsApp — Privacy & destined match
body:
Assalamu alaikum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh 🌿

There is someone written for you. And you deserve to find them in a way that honours that.

✨ *Date Khaas* is a Muslim matrimony app built on three promises:

🔒 *Your photos are private.* Blurred by default — unlocked only by your choice, one person at a time.

✔️ *Every profile is verified.* ID-checked and selfie-matched before they can reach you. Real people only.

👨‍👩‍👧 *Your wali is welcome.* Invite your father or brother to follow your journey with you — because a nikah is never just two people.

We are in peak wedding season right now. Thousands of families are searching with their children on Date Khaas this month.

Begin yours → https://datekhaas.com/join

_Reply STOP to opt out._

research_sources.insight: Muslim wedding season peaks May–July 2026; highest-intent period for matrimony sign-ups.
77.8% of Muslim singles use matchmaking apps; photo privacy and ID verification are top concerns.
Wali invite is now an explicit in-app feature; family-involvement signals drive trust.
NikahForever claims '4M verified users, 70K marriages'; Shaadi.com claims '80 lakh success stories' + blue-tick screening.
ShadiAmour UK markets '500+ verified halal marriages in UK 2026' targeting NRI diaspora.
Verification framed as a dignity signal converts better than security-language in faith-aware copy.
